requestType.description: Type of authorization request. ChangeOfEnergySupplierForOrganization: change of energy supplier on existing metering points. MoveInAndChangeOfEnergySupplierForOrganization: move-in combined with a change of energy supplier. EnergySupplierFrameworkAgreement: framework agreement between the energy supplier and the customer, resulting in a persistent grant.

status.description: Status of the request. Pending: awaiting a decision. Approved: the request was approved. Rejected: the request was rejected. Expired: validTo passed before a decision was made.

textReference.description: Reference to the authorization text associated with the request, set by the server.

textLanguage.description: Language of the authorization text presented to the user when approving or rejecting the request.

requestedScopes.description: Scopes requested for the authorization grant created when the request is approved.

externalReference.description: The caller's own reference, returned unchanged.

requestedGrantValidFrom.description: Requested start of validity for the authorization grant created when the request is approved. Only used for EnergySupplierFrameworkAgreement.

requestedGrantValidTo.description: Requested end of validity for the authorization grant created when the request is approved. Only used for EnergySupplierFrameworkAgreement.

redirectUri.description: Absolute HTTPS URI the user is redirected to after approving or rejecting the request. The host must match, or be a subdomain of, the redirect URL registered in Ediel for the requestedBy agent.

requestedPrincipal.description: Identifier of the agent the authorization concerns, for example the owner of the metering point. The resolved agent becomes requestedPrincipal on the request.

requestedOf.description: Identifier of the agent asked to approve the request. The resolved agent becomes requestedOf on the request.
